gloss: to announce publicly; to make public; to release

definitions.gloss: to announce publicly; to make public; to publish; to release officially
definitions.explanation: To formally disclose information, data, or decisions to the general public. Implies an official or authoritative release of information that was previously not publicly available.

examples.japanese: ⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{公表|こうひょう}した。
examples.english: The survey results were made public.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{公表|こうひょう}した。
examples.english: The government announced the new policy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{四半期|しはんき}→四半期：10103_shihanki⟧ごと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{財務|ざいむ}→財務：05971_zaimu⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{公表|こうひょう}する⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Companies are obligated to publicly release financial information every quarter.

notes:
Used when information is officially released to the public. Carries a sense of formality and authority — typically the subject is an organization, government body, or institution rather than an individual.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{公表|こうひょう}する: to release results
- ⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{公表|こうひょう}する: to make information public
- ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{公表|こうひょう}する: to release a name
- ⟦{公表|こうひょう}→公表：11640_kouhyou⟧⟦{済|ず}み→〜済み：04013_zumi⟧: already made public

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{発表|はっぴょう}する→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧: to announce — broader, includes presentations, press conferences, and academic announcements
- ⟦{公開|こうかい}→公開：11665_koukai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to open to the public — often used for making physical things or media accessible (buildings, films, documents)
- ⟦{公言|こうげん}→公言：19584_kougen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to state publicly — personal declarations rather than official data releases
